Hamilton and the other Buds would be kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in Vault 31, periodically thawed out and transferred to [[Vault 32]] or [[Vault 33|33]] to manage the dwellers and participate in controlled breeding (eugenics), all under Askins' supervision.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So what's Vault 32 and 33? Just people to be controlled?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"What? No! When you put it like that, it sounds downright morally questionable. They're our breeding pool, the ultimate expression of HR R&D. '''Scavenger Tom''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Tom is the leader of a group of [[Scavenger (TV series)|scavengers]] active around the [[New California]]n town of [[Filly]], which includes a [[Filly huge man|huge man]] as the muscle of the group.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Head]]===
Tom and his crew are seen rummaging through [[Maximus]]' [[T-60 power armor (TV series)|T-60 power armor]] until Maximus approaches them and demands that they step away from the armor. Cackling at Maximus' false bravado, Tom orders his scavenger underlings to kick the shit out of him. He then steps aside and watches as his scavengers do as they're told. When Maximus is restrained by two of the scavengers, Tom approaches him and claims, "Finders keepers, milord," and punches him in the face until he's barely conscious.
